name: dependency backed 02 vite vue runtime
task: Extend the accumulated project by replacing the TODO implementations in src/vite-vue-cart.mjs. Use the installed Vue, Vite, and esbuild packages already wired by the skeleton. Also implement async transformTypedPriceModule(source), using Vite transformWithEsbuild to transform TypeScript into executable JavaScript and returning the generated code string. Inspect the harness, run all tests with validate_project, review the final structured Git diff, and report verified evidence.
constraints: Modify only src/vite-vue-cart.mjs and preserve the passing Next stage.
Import reactive and computed from vue and transformWithEsbuild from vite; esbuild is already installed as Vite's explicit peer dependency, so use no local substitutes.
Do not alter dependencies or harness files.
If an immutable dependency is unavailable, report the blocker after one confirming validation instead of probing repeatedly.
Use validate_project and git_operation before completion.
